title: ft blend
parentNote: Today's blend is ft, the ending in gift and soft and lift. It is a hard one to hear because the f is a long breathy sound and the t is a tiny tap right on the end of it, so children often stop at the f and read "soft" as "sof". Have them hold the f out — sooooff — and then tap the t with the tip of the tongue, and point out that their teeth are on their lip for the f and let go for the t. The other thing that happens is the two sounds getting swapped round, so "lift" comes out "lifet"; if that happens, slow the whole word down rather than just the ending.

activities.mouthCue: Top teeth on your bottom lip to hiss the f, then let go and tap your tongue for the t.
activities.prompt: This pair is not like sh or ch. Here you really do hear both letters — they are just in a hurry.
One of these stops with a little tap on the end. Find the one with the tap.
Two of these are half of the third. Find the one that is both.
Four sounds. Do not let the t slip off the end.
Only the first sound has changed. Keep the ending exactly the same.
Hold the f for a long time, then tap the t: sooooff-t.
A team at the front and the new blend at the back.
A daft dog is a silly one.
Listen right to the very end. Is there an f in there or not?
Same again. The word is longer than it sounds.
All three start with the same hiss. This time the clue is at the end.

activities.text: Pam did lift the soft cat off the mat.
Jim got a gift and did grin.
The raft did tip and Tim got damp.

activities.title: The gift on the raft
activities.prompt: Read the story one line at a time. Tap any word you want to hear again.
lines: Jim did lift a big gift on the raft.
The raft did tip and the gift did drop in the pond.
Pam did hop in the pond and got the gift back.
The gift had a soft hat in it.
Pam had the hat on and did grin at Jim.
